stemMd: No marble samples are flexible. Some display samples are marble. Which conclusion is necessary?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Some display samples are not flexible.

explanationMd: The display samples that are marble inherit the non-flexibility stated for all marble samples. Their existence establishes that some display samples are not flexible. Nothing fixes the properties of the remaining samples.

distractorRationale.a: Only some are identified as marble.
distractorRationale.e: The exclusion cannot be reversed that way.
